title: FACT or Fiction: Can Truthful Mechanisms Eliminate Federated Free Riding? (code)
description: Official code for FACT (Federated Agent Cost Truthfulness), the federated learning mechanism introduced in FACT or Fiction: Can Truthful Mechanisms Eliminate Federated Free Riding? (NeurIPS 2024). FACT eliminates free riding with a penalty, makes agents truthful about their costs through a sandwich competition, and is individually rational. Includes training code for CIFAR-10, MNIST and HAM10000, per-agent logs of every run in the paper, and scripts that regenerate all figures.
